description: This file declares utility functions and classes for string manipulation, Unicode string conversions, and variable interpolation, used within the Battle for Wesnoth project.

classes.name: variable_set
classes.description: Abstract base class for a set of variables, providing a method to retrieve variable values.

classes.name: utils::utf8_iterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing UTF-8 encoded strings as wide characters.

classes.name: utils::invalid_utf8_exception
classes.description: Exception thrown for invalid UTF-8 sequences.

methods.name: variable_set::get_variable_const
methods.description: Pure virtual method to retrieve a constant reference to a variable by its ID.

methods.name: utils::utf8_iterator::utf8_iterator
methods.description: Constructor initializing the iterator with a string or string range.

methods.name: utils::utf8_iterator::operator++
methods.description: Pre-increment operator to advance the iterator.

methods.name: utils::utf8_iterator::operator*
methods.description: Dereference operator to get the current wchar_t.

methods.name: utils::wstring_to_string
methods.description: Converts a wide_string to a UTF-8 encoded std::string.

methods.name: utils::string_to_wstring
methods.description: Converts a UTF-8 std::string to a wide_string.

methods.name: utils::wchar_to_string
methods.description: Converts a wchar_t to a std::string.

methods.name: utils::utf8_string_to_ucs2_string
methods.description: Converts a UTF-8 string to UCS2 encoding.

methods.name: utils::ucs2_string_to_utf8_string
methods.description: Converts a UCS2 string to UTF-8 encoding.

methods.name: utils::capitalize
methods.description: Returns a string with the first letter capitalized.

methods.name: utils::uppercase
methods.description: Returns an uppercased version of the string.

methods.name: utils::lowercase
methods.description: Returns a lowercased version of the string.

methods.name: vgettext
methods.description: Wrapper function for variable interpolation and gettext.
